text:
Anya K: Quick pulse — planning a tiny KB brush-up (micro-sprint) this Friday 12-2pm PT. Goal: fix < 10 broken links, update 3 curl snippets, and pick up two runbook screenshot rehosts. Who's in? :calendar:
Matt B: I can take 3 link fixes and one curl snippet. Which files are highest priority?
Sarah L: I saw the curl snippet in /runbooks/canary-deploy.md is missing -- we should replace the old `curl -XPOST` example. Also images in /runtime/kv-cache.md 404s.
docs-bot: Scan summary: 8 dead links found, 2 outdated snippets. Report: https://internal/reports/kb-scan/1715054321 :robot_face:
Olivia: ping @Matt B @Jeff R — please tag ownership in frontmatter (kb_owner) when you open PRs. Also suggest using `kb-claim: micro-sprint-1715` so we can track.
Jeff R: I'll review CRs for runtime docs if @Matt B or @Sarah L send them. Tag me with :eyes: in the PR.
Matt B: Thx — @Sarah L which curl replacement do you want? I can draft the PR. Also, small Q: what's our PR size preference for micro-sprint? keep to < 10 files?
Sarah L: Yes keep them small. For the deploy snippet, use the new token header example: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"x"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate```
Anya K: Great. Two action items: (1) @Matt B take the canary and three links; (2) @Sarah L take kv-cache image rehost + one snippet. Add `kb_owner` and `kb-claim` to PRs. I'll create a tiny tracking sheet and link it in this thread.
Matt B: On it — will open PRs and tag @Jeff R for review. ETA EOD Thursday for drafts.
docs-bot: Reminder: local link check command:
```
# run from repo root
scripts/linkcheck --path sources/kb --output report.html
```
Olivia: Also check frontmatter for `last_reviewed` date — update to today's date in your PRs.
Jeff R: If anyone hits flaky staging images, ping infra-oncall, mention `staging-cdn` in the ticket.
Anya K: Awesome, thanks team. If nobody objects, I'll book the 12-2 slot and post the sheet link here shortly. :sparkles:
Matt B: fine by me :thumbsup:
Sarah L: me too
Olivia: thanks! :)
